problem: Find the imaginary part of the matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}8+\text{i} & 3-4\text{i} \\ 9 & \text{i}\end{aligned}].$

feedback.problem: If $\,\text{Re}(x)=[\begin{aligned}a & b \\ c & d\end{aligned}]\,$ and $\,\text{Im}(x)=[\begin{aligned}e & f \\ g & h\end{aligned}]\,$ are the real and imaginary parts of the matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}2-\text{i} & 1+3\text{i} \\ -1-4\text{i} & 2-2\text{i}\end{aligned}]\,$ then what is the value of $ab+ef?$
feedback.worked_solution:
For the given matrix $A,$ we have that

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}2-\text{i} & 1+3\text{i} \\ -1-4\text{i} & 2-2\text{i}\end{aligned}] \\  & ={{[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ -1 & 2\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{\text{Re}(A)}+\text{i}{{[\begin{aligned}-1 & 3 \\ -4 & -2\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{\text{Im}(A)}.\end{aligned}
$$

So we have $a=2,b=1,e=-1$ and $f=3.$ Therefore,

$$
ab+ef=2\cdot 1+(-1)\cdot 3=-1.
$$
